findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "nichedb_vuln_lookup" is 1019 chars, far longer than this server's median (189). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: [NicheDB] Everything known about one vulnerability, as an OpenVuln record (a valid OSV record). Give `id`: a CVE (CVE-2026-12537), GHSA, OSV, PYSEC, GO, RUSTSEC…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "p0dcasters_list_episodes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: [p0dcasters] The episodes of one show, newest first, read live from the publisher's feed (cached half an hour): title, date, duration, description, audio URL. F…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
